text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days of training with Kawakami 
Princess are finally beginning! Starting 
right away today...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Nowaaaaah~~!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek?! The MagiPri rental has already 
started, you sayyy?! Ready to rent 
already?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, my personal bible is the original 
series, though! Episode 8 is especially 
legendary! The two get into a fight, 
exchanging blows with their fists to clash 
their ideals...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The rental shop, of course! They have 
every single volume of "Prifight" here!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer-san, you want to know more 
about me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try to recall the events that led up to 
this. If I remember correctly, this 
morning—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I had called Kawakami 
Princess to the Trainer's office early in 
the morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before afternoon training starts, I wanted 
to review best courses and running 
styles...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Mhm, mhm. And then?
choice_data_list: I want you to tell me more about yourself.
I want you to tell me more about yourself

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my! I see, I see... I 
unnn-der-stand completely now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Follow my lead, then! Hey, come on! Bring 
on whatever you've got~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"If you wish to know me, you must start 
with the original! 'Bakusou Mouhime ☆ 
Princess Fighter'!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Rubbing my sleepy eyes, I woke up early on 
Sundays. Watching the heroic Pre-Fi, young 
as I was, I learned what it truly meant to 
be a princess...
choice_data_list:
...Could you wait a moment while I sort 
things out?

...Hold on a second while I sort out the 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Understood, I shall wait for you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"PriFigh," which Kawakami Princess talks 
about, is an anime broadcast on Sunday 
mornings. The protagonist is said to have 
served as the foundation for the kind of 
"princess" she aspires to be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, what I wanted to know this time 
wasn't info on PreFie, but rather—
choice_data_list:
I wanted to know more about your 
running...

I wanted to know more about your 
running...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...My running? Mine?
choice_data_list: Ah, for your debut race, too
Yeah, for your debut race too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...My debut race? Ah, I see, so that's 
why..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Migyaaaaah~!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah... I completely misunderstood, 
didn't I?! Jeez, you big dummy in a 
panic!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry back to the Trainer's office! 
I'll explain and demonstrate everything 
right now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, she dashed out of the 
shop at full throttle, leaving me in the 
dust once again."

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text:
"A true princess must be! Splendid, 
elegant, and valiant! Blazing Princess ☆ 
Princess Fighter!! Nothing can stop a 
dreaming heart!"
choice_data_list:
So this is the Pre-Phy she likes so much, 
huh...

So this is the Pre-Phy she likes so 
much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Time passed, and it was now afternoon. 
Based on the information confirmed earlier 
regarding her preferred courses and 
attributes, we began training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Deeeeeyaaaaahhhhh~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... How was... that...? 
Trai... ner...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I compare the information I gathered 
beforehand with the way she is running 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than extremely short or long 
distances, races from mile to medium 
distance seem best suited for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And above all, the determination to give 
it her all. In the real race with rivals 
present, her spirit is sure to ignite—"
choice_data_list:
..."You can be stronger than a raging 
storm."

..."You can become stronger than a raging 
storm."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat!? Th-Th-That's... !!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's the famous line the "Legendary 
Trainer" in PriFai delivers in episode 16! 
Showing PriFai's true fighting spirit as 
she clashes against her nemesis, 
Yametokee...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait, what! You knew about this, Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
I figured since I have the chance, I might 
as well try studying.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: The "ideal self" that you yearn to be.
The "ideal form" that you yearn for.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, ehehe...♪ Thank you very much, 
indeed...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I shall do one more run!! Trainer, 
please keep your eyes on me~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Doryaryarya, heave-hoooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess kept running with a 
bright smile, calling out with a spirited 
shout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Headstrong as she was, seeing her sprint 
headlong toward becoming the 'ideal 
princess' looked truly radiant."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Her greatest weapon is definitely that 
honesty of hers.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! That's right, my name is King! 
The first-rate Umamusume, King Halo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Calling herself first-class, she is the 
Umamusume Kawakami Princess admires. 
Having already debuted, she is active as a 
Senior-class Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And as for you...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're right. That's why you need to guide 
her well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Honesty can be a weapon, and at times, a 
vulnerability.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you raise it with utmost care. 
For there are Umamusume who have been 
saved by it."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that's not fair! You're a 
cheater! Getting to talk with King-san 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please let me join in as well! Or else I'm 
going to pout!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...My, my. It seems your honesty has 
backfired on you already.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days of taking on the 
Twinkle Series alongside the tomboy 
Umamusume, Kawakami Princess.
